# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by `python -m public_health_framework.config_schema --write docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every PHFrame project is described by a `phframe.yaml` file. This page documents configuration version 1; the machine-readable JSON Schema is [`phframe.schema.json`](phframe.schema.json), which editors such as VS Code can use for completion by adding `# yaml-language-server: $schema=<url of phframe.schema.json>` to the top of the file.

## Versioning and validation

- Declare `version: 1` at the top of the file. `phframe new` writes it for you.
- A file with `version: 1` must match the schema exactly: unknown keys, wrong types, and values outside the allowed set stop `phframe check`, `phframe serve`, and every other command with an error naming the key, such as `datasets.case_reports.fields.cases.requird: unknown key; did you mean 'required'?`.
- A file without `version` is read as a 0.9 preview project. It loads as before, and `phframe check` prints each schema finding as a warning so it can be fixed before adding `version: 1`.
- Any other version is rejected, so a project written for a newer PHFrame is never misread.
- A new configuration version is introduced only in a major release, with a documented migration.
- After the schema check, PHFrame also checks references between sections: indicators, rules, filters, dimensions, widgets, and connectors must name datasets and fields that exist; measure fields must be numeric; `date_field` must be a date or datetime field; thresholds must name an indicator; and the organisation-unit hierarchy must not contain cycles.
- Connectors created through `POST /api/connectors` are checked against the same schema before they are saved.

## Example

```yaml
version: 1

project:
  name: Malaria Surveillance
  database: ${DATABASE_URL}
  environment: production

datasets:
  case_reports:
    fields:
      case_id: {type: identifier, required: true, protected: true}
      report_date: {type: date, required: true}
      district: location
      cases: {type: integer, required: true}
      population: integer

indicators:
  incidence_per_1000:
    dataset: case_reports
    operation: rate
    numerator: cases
    denominator: population
    multiplier: 1000
    date_field: report_date

dashboards:
  main:
    widgets:
      - {type: kpi, indicator: incidence_per_1000}
      - {type: epi_curve, dataset: case_reports, date_field: report_date, value_field: cases}
```

## Environment variables

| Variable | Overrides | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PHFRAME_CONFIG` | — | Path of the configuration file loaded by `public_health_framework.runtime:app` (ASGI servers such as uvicorn). Default `phframe.yaml`. |
| `PHFRAME_DATABASE_URL` | `project.database` | Replaces the database URL. |
| `PHFRAME_ENV` | `project.environment` | Replaces the environment. |
| `PHFRAME_HOST` | `server.host` | Replaces the bind address. |
| `PHFRAME_PORT` | `server.port` | Replaces the port. |

## Top-level keys

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | integer | yes |  | Configuration schema version. Files without it are read as 0.9 preview projects. |
| `project` | object | yes |  | Project identity and storage. |
| `server` | object |  |  | Address that `phframe serve` binds to. |
| `datasets` | map of [Dataset](#dataset) |  |  | Datasets keyed by name. |
| `indicators` | map of [Indicator](#indicator) |  |  | Indicators keyed by name. |
| `data_quality` | map of [DataQualityRule](#dataqualityrule) |  |  | Data-quality rules keyed by name. |
| `filters` | map of [SavedFilter](#savedfilter) |  |  | Saved filters keyed by name. |
| `dimensions` | map of [Dimension](#dimension) |  |  | Dimensions keyed by name. |
| `thresholds` | map of [Threshold](#threshold) |  |  | Surveillance thresholds keyed by name. |
| `organisation_units` | map of [OrganisationUnit](#organisationunit) |  |  | Organisation units keyed by code. |
| `dashboards` | map of [Dashboard](#dashboard) |  |  | Dashboards keyed by name. |
| `ui` | object |  |  | Browser application appearance. |
| `connectors` | map of [Connector](#connector) |  |  | Connectors keyed by name. |
| `plugins` | list of string |  | `[]` | Plugins loaded at start-up, in order, written as `module` or `module:attribute`. Each must provide `setup(app, config)`. |

## `project`

Project identity and storage.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  | Project name shown in the application header. |
| `database` | string |  | `"sqlite:///data/phframe.db"` | SQLAlchemy database URL. Relative SQLite paths resolve against the configuration file. `${NAME}` is replaced by the environment variable `NAME`. |
| `environment` | string |  | `"development"` | Deployment environment. `production` turns on the production readiness checks and disallows `phframe serve --reload`. One of `development`, `test`, `production`. |

## `server`

Address that `phframe serve` binds to.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `host` | string |  | `"127.0.0.1"` | Address to bind. |
| `port` | integer |  | `8000` | Port to bind. 1–65535. |

## `ui`

Browser application appearance.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `theme` | string |  | `"light"` | Default colour theme. One of `light`, `dark`, `high-contrast`. |
| `locale` | string |  | `"en"` | Interface language, such as `en` or `en-US`. Matches `^[a-z]{2}(-[A-Z]{2})?$`. |
| `translations` | map of scalar |  | `{}` | Interface strings keyed by message id. |

## Definitions

### Field

A dataset field: either a field type name, or an object with the type and options.

- Shorthand for `{type: <name>}`. One of `age`, `boolean`, `case_classification`, `date`, `datetime`, `disease_code`, `epi_week`, `facility`, `identifier`, `integer`, `location`, `number`, `organisation_unit`, `reporting_period`, `sex`, `string`.
- An object with the keys below.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | string |  | `"string"` | Field type. Determines storage and validation. One of `age`, `boolean`, `case_classification`, `date`, `datetime`, `disease_code`, `epi_week`, `facility`, `identifier`, `integer`, `location`, `number`, `organisation_unit`, `reporting_period`, `sex`, `string`. |
| `required` | boolean |  | `false` | Records must provide a value. |
| `protected` | boolean |  | `false` | Treated as sensitive: excluded from AI evidence and flagged by publication review. |
| `label` | string |  |  | Display name. Defaults to the field name in title case. |

### Dataset

A dataset stored as a database table with generated record endpoints.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | string |  |  | Display name. Defaults to the dataset name in title case. |
| `fields` | map of [Field](#field) | yes |  | Fields keyed by name. At least one is required. |

### Indicator

A declarative indicator calculated over one dataset.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | string |  |  | Display name. Defaults to the indicator name in title case. |
| `dataset` | string | yes |  | Name of a dataset defined in `datasets`. |
| `operation` | string |  | `"count"` | Calculation to perform. One of `average`, `count`, `percentage`, `rate`, `ratio`, `sum`. |
| `field` | string |  |  | Numeric field to sum or average. Required for `sum` and `average`. |
| `numerator` | string |  |  | Numeric numerator field. Required for `rate`, `ratio`, and `percentage`. |
| `denominator` | string |  |  | Numeric denominator field. Required for `rate`, `ratio`, and `percentage`. |
| `multiplier` | number |  |  | Scale applied to the result. Defaults to 100 for `percentage` and 1 otherwise. |
| `date_field` | string |  |  | Date or datetime field used for reporting periods. |
| `filters` | object |  | `{}` | Field values every counted record must match. |

- When `operation` is `sum` or `average`, `field` must be set.
- When `operation` is `rate` or `ratio` or `percentage`, `numerator` and `denominator` must be set.

### DataQualityRule

A data-quality rule evaluated over one field.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | string |  |  | Display name. Defaults to the rule name in title case. |
| `dataset` | string | yes |  | Name of a dataset defined in `datasets`. |
| `field` | string | yes |  | Field the rule checks. |
| `check` | string |  | `"required"` | `required` flags missing values, `range` flags numbers outside min/max, `allowed` flags values outside a list. One of `allowed`, `range`, `required`. |
| `min` | number |  |  | Lowest accepted value for a `range` check. |
| `max` | number |  |  | Highest accepted value for a `range` check. |
| `values` | list of scalar |  |  | Accepted values for an `allowed` check. |

- When `check` is `range`, `min` or `max` must be set.
- When `check` is `allowed`, `values` must be set.

### SavedFilter

A reusable set of field values for indicator and dimension queries.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | string |  |  | Display name. Defaults to the filter name in title case. |
| `dataset` | string | yes |  | Name of a dataset defined in `datasets`. |
| `values` | object | yes |  | Field values to match, keyed by field name. |

### Dimension

A grouped count of records by one field.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | string |  |  | Display name. Defaults to the dimension name in title case. |
| `dataset` | string | yes |  | Name of a dataset defined in `datasets`. |
| `field` | string | yes |  | Field to group by. |
| `filter` | string |  |  | Name of a saved filter defined in `filters` for the same dataset. |

### Threshold

A surveillance alert evaluated against an indicator.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | string |  |  | Display name. Defaults to the threshold name in title case. |
| `indicator` | string | yes |  | Name of an indicator defined in `indicators`. |
| `operator` | string |  | `"gte"` | Comparison between the indicator value and `value`. One of `eq`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`. |
| `value` | number | yes |  | Alert level. |
| `severity` | string |  | `"warning"` | Alert severity. One of `info`, `warning`, `critical`. |
| `message` | string |  |  | Message shown when the threshold is met. |

### OrganisationUnit

A node in the organisation-unit hierarchy, keyed by its code.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  | Display name. |
| `level` | string | yes |  | Hierarchy level, such as country, district, or facility. |
| `parent` | string |  |  | Code of the parent unit. The hierarchy may not contain cycles. |

### Widget

A dashboard widget.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | string | yes |  | `kpi` shows an indicator, `chart` and `map` show a dimension, `epi_curve` plots records over time. One of `kpi`, `chart`, `map`, `epi_curve`. |
| `title` | string |  |  | Widget heading. Defaults to the widget type in title case. |
| `indicator` | string |  |  | Indicator shown by a `kpi` widget. |
| `dimension` | string |  |  | Dimension shown by a `chart` or `map` widget. |
| `dataset` | string |  |  | Dataset plotted by an `epi_curve` widget. |
| `date_field` | string |  |  | Date or datetime field on the x-axis of an `epi_curve` widget. |
| `value_field` | string |  |  | Numeric field summed per period by an `epi_curve` widget. Records are counted when omitted. |

- When `type` is `kpi`, `indicator` must be set.
- When `type` is `chart` or `map`, `dimension` must be set.
- When `type` is `epi_curve`, `dataset` and `date_field` must be set.

### Dashboard

A configured dashboard.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | string |  |  | Display name. Defaults to the dashboard name in title case. |
| `widgets` | list of [Widget](#widget) |  | `[]` | Widgets in display order. |

### Connector

A scheduled pull from an external data source into a dataset.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | string | yes |  | Source system. One of `api`, `dhis2`, `kobo`, `odk`. |
| `dataset` | string | yes |  | Dataset that receives the records. |
| `base_url` | string | yes |  | Server address. Must start with `http://` or `https://`. Matches `^https?://`. |
| `resource` | string | yes |  | Resource path, form id, or DHIS2 data set id on the server. |
| `records_path` | string |  |  | Dot-separated path to the record list when the response nests it. |
| `mapping` | map of string | yes |  | Source field names mapped to dataset field names. At least one is required. |
| `auth` | object |  |  | Names of environment variables that hold credentials. Secrets never go in the file. |
| `auth.token_env` | string |  |  | Variable holding an API token. |
| `auth.username_env` | string |  |  | Variable holding a user name for basic authentication. |
| `auth.password_env` | string |  |  | Variable holding a password for basic authentication. |
| `parameters` | map of scalar |  |  | Extra query parameters sent with each request. |
| `timeout` | integer |  | `30` | Request timeout in seconds. 1–300. |
| `schedule_minutes` | integer |  |  | Minutes between scheduled runs by `phframe worker`. Manual only when omitted. At least 1. |
